steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Gah—
You're awake.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: ...Who are you?

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: Call me Arges.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: I foresaw an accident in the forest today, so I decided to patrol the area, where I found you unconscious in the snow.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: ...Have you seen my companions?

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: ...Tch, I should go look for them.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Gah—

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: You're quite injured. You should rest here first.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: You don't seem to be from Sami.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: ...My friends and I were looking for a way home, and a guy called Oakcup told us Sami's will was guiding us to go north.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: Oakcup... the oak-child.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: You know him?

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: I've heard that in Sami the name is synonymous with 'wisdom.'

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: 'Wisdom'...? Then... Do you know of the Cyclopes?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: ...What's wrong?

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: I have witnessed many ensnared by misfortune. Death itself... is no stranger to me.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: Yet, why do I see so many deaths in you?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: No sign of Chilchuck?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: We should at least be glad for the thick snow and trees here. He should have handled that fall easily.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Mm... but he isn't the greatest at self-defense, so we should still find him as fast as we can.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: It'll be terrible if he ran into that hornbeast from earlier.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Aye. But we have another problem—
Sorry.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: *sigh*...It's not your fault.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: But what are you doing all by yourself in this forest, miss?
I'm hunting...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Do you live here, lass?
Nope, I live on Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: RHODES ISLAND?! That's the place we've been looking for.
Huh? You wanna go to Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Yeah, we're trying to find our way home, and someone told us we could get help there.
You lost your home? So sad...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: So can you take us to Rhodes Island?
Eh... But I don't wanna go back yet...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Why not?
'Cause I'm still hungry!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Is that all?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Then if we feed you till you're satisfied, will you take us there?
Mm, sure!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...I didn't expect to find a lead like this.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Could this be what Sami was guiding us towards all along?
But...
I still haven't found my prey.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: We have our own food—Ah.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Guess we lost it all in the chaos earlier.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: ...How about this?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: First, you help us find our companion. Then, we'll help you hunt whatever you want. And finally, you take us to Rhodes Island.
Mm! Okay!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: What an innocent lass. What's your name?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I'm Ceobe, but you can call me Kay!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: You saw death in me...?

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: Many deaths, in fact. Both in the past and the future, yet here you stand now, alive.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: That Oakcup guy said Cyclopes can see the future.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Are you one of them?

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Then please, tell me my fate.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: ...Cyclopes can only see doom.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: That's fine. Just tell me the fates of me and my companions.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: Your companions walk toward the endless icefields...

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: No, they do not go of their own will. They were... swallowed up, by the dark and the void.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: What's that mean?

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: They were corrupted by demons.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Demons?! No one mentioned any demons!

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: Demons... are a vagrant existence on this land.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: They corrode and envelop all that they touch.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: Corrupted creatures lose all sense of self, as if swallowed into the void—

a.text: On its face is a black... black? No, it is a blank, an endless void.
The first thing that comes to mind is the galaxy of stars one can see in the night sky.
A cow with a void as its face. They find this reality hard to believe.
What's even more shocking is what lies dead center in the blank space. A circle.
A circle somehow even darker than the void surrounding it.
Darker than the night, deeper than the void.
But how can this dark circle seem to emit light?
Because it isn't. The circle is really a hole that sucks in all the light near it, to the point that it seems to be glowing.
Darker than the night, brighter than the light...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Those creatures have a circle on their faces...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Just like a single eye on a head.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: Have you already seen a corrupted creature?!
Chilchuck ponders for a moment before pressing his hand on his injured arm and exiting the cave.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Can a doom you see be avoided?

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: All I can say is that I try.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: ...Then so will I.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: So you're saying Rhodes Island is a giant ship?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Yeah! It's huuuge and it goes everywhere!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Oh, so that's why we never found it!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: *sniff*

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Smells like blood. My prey's blood. The one-eyed monster is nearby!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: What a keen sense of smell.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hm? Kay, did you just say 'one-eyed monster'?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Yeah. A hornbeast with only one eye on its face. So a 'one-eyed monster,' right?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Eek... do you guys still remember what Oakcup said?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: About the Cyclopes.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Could he have guessed wrong?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Maybe Sami didn't mean for us to find an actual Cyclops.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Maybe It just predicted we would find Kay, and knew we would encounter a 'hornbeast' like that?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Either way, since we've run into it again...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: We'll just have to deal with it.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Is it dead?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Phew... Then I guess we can consider Chilchuck avenged.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Now let's go find him.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I've got a suggestion.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: What if we started a fire here, instead of running around aimlessly?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: It might attract some wild beasts, but Chilchuck could spot us too.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Uh... But—

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Either way, we can't really do much on an empty stomach.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Even if he doesn't see it, we should feed ourselves first if we want the energy to keep searching afterward.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: So what do we do with this 'one-eyed' hornbeast?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Let's eat it! Together!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Aye, sounds good.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I've heard of traditions where people will kill and eat an animal as a sacrifice to the gods, hoping for divine revelation.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: My guess is the will of Sami was hoping for us to do something similar.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Then—

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Don't even try to pretend, Laios. You were planning to eat it from the start.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Let's start a fire first.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Hopefully, Chilchuck will see it.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: It's done!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Ugh—I'm being serious here, the meat looks bizarre.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Already tasted it. Doesn't seem too different from regular meat.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Fine, I guess. We've already eaten stranger things than this.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Wow, it's actually pretty good!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What are you doing over there, Kay?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Looking to see if there's an even bigger one!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Hoo, guess not. No sight of that Durin who fell earlier either.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Come join us for a meal first. We'll go look for him together afterward.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Okay, coming!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Hey—!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Whoa! You're that Durin!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: *pant*—*pant*—

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: And you're the girl who popped out of nowhere.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Sorry I made you fall.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*... It's fine. You guys alright?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Mm, we're all good.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Great.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I knew that doom was avoidable.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: They're making steaks and skewers over there. Said they'll keep looking for you after eating.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Let's go together? I bet they'll be so happy to see you.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Tch. Of course they're eating even at a time like this. What was I worried about?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Wait, steak? What kind of steak?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: The 'One-eyed monster' kind.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: 'One-eyed monster'?!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: You guys... they can't have...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Oh look, here they come.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Perfect timing. I'm going to give them a piece of my mind—

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Hey, you guys can't just—
Chilchuck turns around and is about to begin scolding his friends for leaving him behind for a barbecue.
But his words clog up in his throat.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Time to go home, guys.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: We have stayed too long in this world.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Falin must be getting anxious.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: It's time to harvest the crops on the golem. I still have Red Dragon meat to cook.
Their faces, now blanketed by the void, are no longer the familiar visages he once knew.
Their voices start to break and distort, until Chilchuck isn't even sure how they're speaking.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: You guys... ate that corrupted hornbeast?!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Chil■■■■■, what are you still ■■■■■ here? Let's go ■■■■.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Where... are you guys going?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: North, the northern ■■■■.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: End, door, go home, go ■■■■.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: There's a door in the north we can use to go home?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Is this Sami's guidance?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: But how do you guys know all this?!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: We ■■■■, we come from that ■■■■.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: ■■ return to that ■■■■.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: P■th, h■m■, F■l■n—
Chilchuck feels a mess of emotions welling up.
Panic and resignation wash over him—doom feels inevitable. His own party members are now in dire straits, and he is powerless to help them.
But he also feels a little angry...
Because the reason for their distress... is entirely their own damn fault!
Chilchuck is sure he only blinked once, but the trio suddenly appear near him.
The next second, they are by his side.
From his perspective, they seem to have moved in a flash, as if the holes in their faces swallowed the space between them.
Soon, they disappear into the depths of the forest.
Chilchuck stands still for a moment before breaking into a deep sigh.
He hears the Cyclops approaching behind him, and sees the puzzled look on the girl's face.
He does not wait or hesitate, but begins sprinting towards where his companions vanished.
He is too embarrassed to explain what happened here to the Cyclops and her sorrowful gaze.
They are his companions after all... of course he can't just watch them disappear for good like that.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: GUYS! COULD YOU JUST—SLOW DOWN!!!
An angry roar echoes in the skies above the Myrkwood, lingering for a long time.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Wait for me! I wanna join you guys too!
